description: dispatch --dry-run against a chain where every entry is unavailable raises ChainExhaustedError before any card is printed: EXIT_NEEDS_CONFIG (3), nothing created, a message naming every skip reason rather than a bare 'no seats'.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-a]
kind = "codex"
short = "sa"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-a}}"
pool = "codex:a"
available = false
unavailable_reason = "codex quota exhausted"

[accounts.seat-b]
kind = "codex"
short = "sb"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-b}}"
pool = "codex:b"
available = false
unavailable_reason = "login expired"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["seat-a", "seat-b"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"

expect.stderr:
every account in the Explorer chain for 'sandbox' is unavailable:
  - seat-a: codex quota exhausted
  - seat-b: login expired
Multiverse will not route to an account outside the chain (route by path, never by quota).
